name: Joshua
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy

points: The cart came into the field of Joshua, a Beth-shemite, and stood by a great stone; they clave the wood of the cart and offered the kine a burnt offering unto the Lord, and the Levites took down the ark and the coffer with the jewels of gold.

note.label: 1 Samuel 6: The Ark Returned with a Trespass Offering
